options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Specific Keys
options.doc: Normal keys are specific to a dungeon. The key count for each dungeon may be found in extra pages in the pause menu. Turn off to make normal keys act like in vanilla. If off, you may need to buy keys from Zaegul.

options.name: Colors Required
options.doc: Number of colors out of 5 needed to enter the Lighthouse.

options.name: Blessings Required
options.doc: Number of blessings out of 5 needed to access Enlightenment or to get the Hero's Rest ending.

options.name: Crest Fragments Required
options.doc: Number of crest fragments out of 5 needed to get past the door in Castle Vann.

options.name: Coins of Crowl Required
options.doc: Number of Coins of Crowl out of 13 needed to get past the underwater door.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
The goal of the game.
var: Defeat Var.
rest: Revive Torran.
shadow: Defeat Shadow Oran.
torran: Defeat Torran.
any: Defeat any of the three.

options.name: Color Locations
options.doc:
Choose where your colors can be found.
dungeon_prizes: Colors can be found on dungeon prizes (Vulture, Tidal Frog, Water Blessing, Rat Potion, Wren, Yhote, Spirit of Vann, Ram Wraith, Loomagnos, Earth Blessing, Color Correction, Light Spirit, Stindle, Frozen Heart, Killer, Siska, Mechanized Slot Machine, Inkwell).
local: Colors can be found anywhere in your own world.
any: Colors can be found in any world.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez où vous pouvez trouver vos couleurs.
dungeon prizes: Couleurs peuvent être trouvées sur les prix du donjon (Vulture, grenouille de marée, Bénédiction de l'eau, Potion de rat, Wren, Yhote, Esprit de Vann, Ram Wraith, Loomagnos, Bénédiction de la Terre, Correction de la couleur, Esprit de lumière, Stindle, Coeur gelé, Tueur, Siska, Machine à sous mécanisée, Inkwell).
local: Les couleurs peuvent être trouvées n'importe où dans votre propre monde.
any: Couleurs peuvent être trouvés dans n'importe quel monde.

options.name: Blessing Locations
options.doc:
Choose where your blessings can be found.
dungeon_prizes: Blessings can be found on dungeon prizes (Vulture, Tidal Frog, Water Blessing, Rat Potion, Wren, Yhote, Spirit of Vann, Ram Wraith, Loomagnos, Earth Blessing, Color Correction, Light Spirit, Stindle, Frozen Heart, Killer, Siska, Mechanized Slot Machine, Inkwell).
local: Blessings can be found anywhere in your own world.
any: Blessings can be found in any world.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez où vous pouvez trouver vos bénédictions.
dungeon prizes: Bénédictions peuvent être trouvées sur les prix du donjon (Vulture, Grenouille Tidale, Bénédiction de l'eau, Potion de rat, Wren, Yhote, Esprit de Vann, Ram Wraith, Loomagnos, Bénédiction de la Terre, Correction de couleur, Esprit de lumière, Stindle, Coeur gelé, Tueur, Siska, Machine à sous mécanisée, Inkwell).
local: Bénédictions peuvent être trouvés n'importe où dans votre propre monde.
any: Bénédictions peuvent être trouvés dans n'importe quel monde.

options.name: Lighthouse Key
options.doc:
Choose where your lighthouse key can be found. (Only applies if Specific Keys is on)
blessings: The lighthouse key is obtained when you return the blessings and get the Hero's Soul.
coins: The lighthouse key is found underwater behind the door requiring coins of Crowl.
materials: The lighthouse key is given to you by Bolivar when you give him the four materials.
local: The lighthouse key may be found anywhere in your own world.
any: The lighthouse key may be found in any world.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez où se trouve votre clé de phare. (S'applique uniquement si les clés spécifiques sont allumées)
bénédictions: La clé du phare est obtenue lorsque vous rendez les bénédictions et obtenez l'âme du héros.
pièces: La clé du phare est trouvée sous l'eau derrière la porte nécessitant des pièces de monnaie de Crowl.
matériaux: La clé du phare vous est donnée par Bolivar quand vous lui donnez les quatre matériaux.
local: La clé du phare peut être trouvée n'importe où dans votre propre monde.
La clé du phare peut être trouvée dans n'importe quel monde.

options.name: Trading Quest
options.doc:
How to handle the trading quest.
vanilla: The Lost Shipment and Ulni checks are randomized. The entire trading quest must be completed as in vanilla to get Ulni's check.
skip: The Lost Shipment location and Anchor Greaves are randomized. The Lost Shipment itself is not randomized, and Ulni is not a check.
shuffle: All items in the trading quest are randomized, and each of the corresponding NPCs is a check.

options.name: Shuffle Grelin Drops
options.doc: Grelin randomly drop four Archipelago items, and the Holy Relic, Wedding Ring, Silver Mirror, and Painting are added to the pool.

options.name: Shuffle Hidden Items
options.doc: Include hidden overworld items in the pool.

options.name: Shuffle Bjerg Castle
options.doc: Include Bjerg Castle (Mariana's marriage dungeon) in the pool. A sailor near the arena will take you there.

options.name: Shuffle Daemon's Dive
options.doc: Include Daemon's Dive in the pool.

options.name: Shuffle Enlightenment
options.doc: Include Enlightenment in the pool.

options.name: Shuffle Secret Shop
options.doc: Include Zaegul's Secret Shop in the pool.

options.name: Skips In Logic
options.doc: The seed may require skips such as side hits, two-tile flare jumps outside of Enlightenment, deleting objects with the Empowered Hand, and interacting with objects from a tile away.

options.name: Start With Spiced Ham
options.doc: Start with a buff that lets you run.

options.name: Start With Winged Boots
options.doc: Start with Winged Boots.

options.name: Skip One Small Favor
options.doc: Tara gives you an item directly instead of requiring you to go on a fetch quest.

options.name: Fake Dread Hand
options.doc: Allow using teleport statues without having the dread hand.
options.doc_fr: Permettre d'utiliser des statues de téléport sans avoir la main redoutée.

options.name: Fast Fishing
options.doc: Only 100 points are required in the fishing minigame to get the item from Keaton and to get free fish.

options.name: Altar to Var
options.doc: Defile the altar to Var. Receive double damage.
options.doc_fr: Détruisez l'autel à Var. Recevoir deux dommages.

options.name: Altar to Zolei
options.doc: Defile the altar to Zolei. Item drops are reduced in frequency, and you must fight Zolei alongside Var.
options.doc_fr: Détruisez l'autel à Zolei. Les gouttes d'article sont réduites en fréquence, et vous devez combattre Zolei aux côtés de Var.

options.name: Altar to Raem
options.doc: Defile the altar to Raem. Raem will attack you with beams of light, and you cannot gain extra HP through prayer.
options.doc_fr: Détruisez l'autel à Raem. Raem vous attaquera avec des faisceaux de lumière, et vous ne pouvez pas gagner plus de HP par la prière.

options.name: Altar to Hate
options.doc: Defile the altar to Hate. Heart ores do not increase your maximum HP.
options.doc_fr: Souillez l'autel à la haine. Les minerais cardiaques n'augmentent pas votre HP maximum.

options.name: Curse of Frailty
options.doc: Accept the curse of frailty. You die in one hit.
options.doc_fr: Acceptez la malédiction de la fragilité. Tu meurs en un seul coup.

options.name: Curse of Famine
options.doc: Accept the curse of famine. You cannot buy buffs.
options.doc_fr: Acceptez la malédiction de la famine. Tu ne peux pas acheter des buffs.

options.name: Curse of Rust
options.doc: Accept the curse of rust. The pick cannot be upgraded, and boots and rings do not work, except for the Winged Boots and Wedding Rings.
options.doc_fr: Acceptez la malédiction de la rouille. Le choix ne peut être amélioré, et les bottes et les anneaux ne fonctionnent pas, à l'exception des bottes ailées et des anneaux de mariage.

options.name: Curse of Wind
options.doc: Accept the curse of wind. Doubles the speed of projectiles.
options.doc_fr: Acceptez la malédiction du vent. Double la vitesse des projectiles.

options.name: Curse of Blooms
options.doc: Accept the curse of blooms. Enemies drop bombs when they die.
options.doc_fr: Acceptez la malédiction des fleurs. Les ennemis lâchent des bombes quand ils meurent.

options.name: Curse of Crowns
options.doc: Accept the curse of crowns. You cannot marry anyone.
options.doc_fr: Acceptez la malédiction des couronnes. Tu ne peux épouser personne.

options.name: Curse of Horns
options.doc: Accept the curse of horns. All junk items, such as gold, are replaced by traps. Note that if no trap options are selected then all traps will be enabled.
options.doc_fr: Acceptez la malédiction des cornes. Tous les articles pourries, comme l'or, sont remplacés par des pièges. Notez que si aucune option de piège n'est sélectionnée, tous les pièges seront activés.

options.name: Curse of Flames
options.doc: Accept the curse of flames. Flames appear behind you as you move through dungeons.
options.doc_fr: Accepter la malédiction des flammes. Des flammes apparaissent derrière vous alors que vous vous déplacez à travers des donjons.

options.name: Trap Chance
options.doc: Percentage chance of an added filler item being a trap. Items in the base pool are not affected. Has no effect if Curse of Horns is active.

options.name: Enable All Traps
options.doc: Enabling this overrides the individual trap settings and enables all types of traps.

options.name: Slowness Traps
options.doc: Enable slowness traps, which prevent you from running for 20 seconds.

options.name: Rust Traps
options.doc: Enable rust traps, which disable boots and rings for 20 seconds.

options.name: Confusion Traps
options.doc: Enable confusion traps, which reverse your movement for 20 seconds.

options.name: Disarming Traps
options.doc: Enable disarming traps, which prevent use of the pick for 20 seconds.

options.name: Light Traps
options.doc: Enable light traps, which attack you with beams of light for 20 seconds.

options.name: Glitch Traps
options.doc: Enable glitch traps, which cause graphical glitches for 20 seconds.

options.name: Zombie Traps
options.doc: Enable zombie traps, which spawn zombies around you.

options.name: Shadow Traps
options.doc: Enable shadow traps, which warp you as though you used the Dread Hand.
